tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Free-text search across 102,191 vehicle variants, 116 brands, 19 languages. Returns candidate variant_ids to pass to get_specs/get_images/compare_variants. Each result carries generation_id and year_from/year_to so same-named variants from different generations can be told apart.

tools.name: get_specs
tools.description: Full localized specs for one vehicle variant, in any of 19 languages — 180 spec types covering engine & fuel, performance, EV/hybrid, safety (30 specs), comfort & interior (47), exterior, chassis, dimensions & weights, consumption (WLTP/NEDC). tools.name: compare_variants
tools.description: Side-by-side localized specs for 2-4 vehicle variants.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: Generations/facelifts of a model, with production years.

tools.name: filter_cars
tools.description: Structured catalog filter: fuel type, body type, drive layout, power/price range, model year, EV-only.

tools.name: get_images
tools.description: Image URLs (own CDN, no attribution burden) for a vehicle variant.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_cars" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
